name: SU (Stress Units)
description: Create's unit for how much power machines use.

pages.title: SU (Stress Units)
pages.text:
**SU**, stress units, measure Create power. Sources give **stress capacity**, machines use **stress impact**, both in su.\
\
Ask for more than the sources give and the network is overstressed. Goggles show the numbers; Shift on a tooltip says Low, Moderate or High impact.
